primitives.summary: Single resume content contract: shape, safe links, PDF path, safe JSON keys and size limit, shared by Convex, the dashboard and the publication build.

guarantees.statement: content.upsertResumeDraft rejects contentJson that fails the contract with a ConvexError before any write.
guarantees.verifiedBy: apps/backend/convex/model/content/resume.ts#upsertResumeDraftHandler calls parseResumePageContent before ctx.db; private probe pr1-resume (aohys-primitives-20261013)

guarantees.statement: The dashboard editor and scripts/apply-dashboard-published-content.ts validate with the same contract; no other resume validator exists.

primitives.summary: One as-const array per domain vocabulary (locale, environment, release environment, lead intent/status/contact path, publication scope/request/attempt state, workflow outcome and provider status, media provider/usage/status, site setting key/classification, environment variable classification, writable media providers, case-study status/evidence); types derive from the arrays and Convex validators derive through literals().

guarantees.statement: Every exported validator in convex/lib/validators.ts wraps exactly the domain array mapped to it in VALIDATOR_VOCABULARIES (literals(<that array>)), and every inventoried vocabulary field of convex/schema.ts references its validator from ./lib/validators.js (only a Convex v.optional wrapper is unwrapped).
guarantees.verifiedBy: pnpm architecture:fitness (domain-vocabulary-derivation, SCHEMA_VOCABULARY_FIELDS in scripts/architecture/domain-vocabulary.mjs); probes with v.string(), a local v.literal and a non-Convex optional wrapper rejected; probes with a validator wired to the wrong array and an unmapped validator rejected

guarantees.statement: convex/schema.ts and convex/lib/validators.ts hold no string v.literal.
content.upsertSiteSetting accepts only keys in SITE_SETTING_KEYS (argument validator).

goals: Literal-copy detection outside the derived Convex files is a best-effort syntactic signal (unions, string arrays, v.union/v.literal lists; stale and drifted copies; per-statement // domain-vocabulary-ok exemption), not a proof that no copy exists; a copy it misses is fixed when found and, if it recurs, the consumer joins the symbol-derivation inventory.

Narrow siteSettings.key in convex/schema.ts to siteSettingKeyValidator and add it to SCHEMA_VOCABULARY_FIELDS once preview and production siteSettings rows are read and every stored key is in SITE_SETTING_KEYS (the argument validator already enforces it on writes).
